articleTitle: UWB technology for wireless video networking
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The proliferation of consumer electronic devices that provide streams of video, such as digital-video disk (DVD) players, high-definition television (HDTV) sets, digital cameras, and digital camcorders, has given rise to significant interest in broadband home entertainment networks. Wireless home networks are particularly attractive because of ease of installation or relocation. However, many existing wireless networks do not satisfy the demands of the home-networking environment, nor do they provide the necessary performance to support multiple audio-video streams. This paper describes the characteristics and the advantages of ultra-wideband (UWB) radio technology when combined with a decentralized, priority-driven network architecture for wireless video networking in the home.

articleTitle: Complexity scalable video decoding via IDCT data pruning
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Resource constraint video decoding is critical for the next generation cost-driven multimedia devices. In this paper, we present a DCT-based computational complexity scalable video decoder via properly pruning the DCT data. Experimental results showed that the complexity can be scaled from 100% to 38% and the output quality is gracefully degraded.

articleTitle: Scalable video algorithms and quality-of-service resource management for consumer terminals
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Execution of video algorithms on programmable platforms is limited by the available resources. A novel approach with scalable algorithms and run-time control of output quality and resource usage can transcend such limitations.

articleTitle: An efficient image indexing algorithm in JPEG compressed domain
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Considering the fact that majority of images stored in computers, such as those from the Internet, are in JPEG compressed format, it would be highly desirable to have the content-based image indexing and retrieval conducted directly in the compressed domain. In this paper, we present a partial decoding algorithm to index images directly in the compressed domain for all JPEG compressed images. Following that, an empirical study is also carried out to compare the performance of such approaches in DCT domain and that of original images in the pixel domain. This technology will prove invaluable in applications where fast image key generation is required such as on the Internet or embedded in future imaging equipment. This is necessary as not only the amount of media available on the Internet will continue to grow but also the amount stored in homes-on digital televisions, computers, cameras and media-will grow.

articleTitle: Image processing techniques to detect and filter objectionable images based on skin tone and shape recognition
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper we describe image-processing techniques to detect and categorize potentially objectionable images based solely on the image content. The techniques include a novel method of matching skin tones based on a fuzzy classification scheme and shape recognition techniques to match faces and other elements of the human anatomy. In particular the color matching technique is significantly more accurate than existing methods documented in literature. These techniques offer a means of filtering images, based solely on graphical content, for a new generation of home Internet appliances.

articleTitle: The residential gateway as service platform
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes an architecture for Internet-based service provisioning to home networks. A residential gateway is introduced to enable access to the Internet for multiple devices, and to serve as a service execution platform. The service software is implemented in Java and dynamically downloaded and installed at the residential gateway following the Open Service Gateway Initiative (OSGI) specification.

articleTitle: Scaling in MPEG-2 decoding loop with mixed processing
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: MPEG-2 decoding with internal resolution scaling degrades video quality particularly for interlaced video with high vertical activities. Previously known methods apply the same algorithm to each picture without utilizing the observation that errors in different types of pictures (I, P, or B) contribute differently to the total degradation. We propose a solution that mixes highand low-complexity algorithms to ensure that more critical pictures are processed with higher quality thereby increasing the overall video quality. Simulation results confirm that such an approach yields a better trade-off between quality and complexity than simply applying a single high- or low-complexity algorithm to all pictures.

articleTitle: Indexing and retrieval of TV news programs based on MPEG-7
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes the results of the study of an existing TV news archive system, which led to the design of a retrieval application using a rich news description model based on the MPEG-7 standard. It also describes the advantages of using MPEG-7 in the indexing, querying and browsing processes.

articleTitle: A software-based high-quality MPEG-2 encoder employing scene change detection and adaptive quantization
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a software-only MPEG encoder implementation which uses adaptive quantization and scene change detection to enhance the picture quality. Scene change detection is also used to assign picture coding types allowing easy, lossless cutting at scene change positions in a later editing process. Although our current implementation concentrates on MPEG-2, all concepts can also be directly applied to MPEG-4 encoders.

articleTitle: Devices, software, their applications and requirements for wearable electronics
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In the field of consumer electronics, this paper presents a production near demonstrator for wearable electronics integrated directly into clothes. The wearable electronics demonstrator discussed and presented is based on the DSP//spl mu/C-two-processor system integrated in a jacket with software functions. It shows speech recording and replay controlled by speech and speakerphone functionality as a demonstration example.

articleTitle: One-pass VBR MPEG encoder using scene adaptive dynamic GOP structure
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an algorithm for one-pass VBR (variable bit rate) MPEG video encoding. We use two techniques to enhance the picture quality in the one-pass VBR coding. One is a scene adaptive dynamic GOP (group of picture) structure control technique according to the picture characteristics estimated by macroblock activity information. The other is a precise bit budget prediction technique for appropriate bit allocation based on the activity and motion characteristics analysis. Since the processing speed of the proposed algorithm is almost equal to that of the conventional CBR (constant bit rate) MPEG encoder, fast VBR encoding can be realized with better picture quality than that of CBR.

articleTitle: A complete single-chip front-end for digital satellite broadcasting
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a single-chip integrating an RF tuner, a demodulator and channel decoder for digital satellite applications. The outstanding achievement is the integration of the zero IF and the demodulation on a standard 0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS process.

articleTitle: Adaptive filtering for image denoising
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive image filter that reduces the amount of noise in images acquired by digital still camera sensors in a Bayer pattern format. The filter acts mainly on the high spatial frequency components of the image in all the areas where they are not perceived by the human visual system (HVS); thus it is an adaptive filter that improves the image quality.

articleTitle: An advanced multimedia processing LSI suitable for HDTV applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have newly developed a multimedia processing LSI, targeting HDTV applications such as a digital broadcasting receiver based on ATSC or ARIB standards. It integrates many essential features such as multiple HDTV/SDTV input and output ports, an MPEG2-I/JPEG decoder, programmable video scaling engines, alpha-blending and a 2-D graphic engine. This LSI will be very useful in a broad range of multimedia applications such as DTV/ATV receivers, set top boxes, interactive TVs, cable and satellite.

articleTitle: Development of an HDTV MPEG-2 encoder based on multiple enhanced SDTV encoding LSIs
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a small, low-power HDTV MPEG-2 encoder based on a spatially parallel encoding approach. The encoder consists of multiple enhanced SDTV encoding LSIs, which have already been used to develop a single-chip, low-power MP@ML MPEG-2 video encoder.

articleTitle: A new contactless battery charger for portable telecommunication/computing electronics
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a new contactless battery charger that is well suited for the applications to the low-profile portable telecommunication/computing electronics such as cellular phones, Internet phones, palm-tops, and other hand-held electronics of the future. The performance of the proposed charger is confirmed with experiments on a prototype charger developed for cellular phones.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an enhanced personal video recorder for HDTV
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a PVR (personal video recorder) that is capable of simultaneous playback and recording of HD quality MPEG-2 streams for digital TV. It provides viewers with a few enhanced features as well as basic features such as pause, instant replay, skip forward and fast forward/rewind in conventional PVRs for analog TV. This paper describes enhanced and new features that are implemented on our PVR.

articleTitle: Building audio and visual home appliances on commodity software
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We describe our currently ongoing work to build distributed middleware for networked audio and visual home appliances, which is executed on commodity software components, Linux and Java.

articleTitle: Optimum frame and frequency synchronization for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an optimum frame and carrier frequency synchronization method for a burst type orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) application such as a wireless local area network (WLAN). In the case of burst transmission, rapid frequency synchronization is essential in order to rapidly achieve orthogonality among subcarriers. By estimating the frequency offset and timing offset before and after the demodulation we can achieve acquisition within one OFDM symbol period. Due to the subcarrier ambiguity in the maximum likelihood estimation (MLS) frequency detector before demodulation, the maximum correctable frequency range is limited to /spl plusmn/1/2 of the subcarrier spacing. This problem can be solved by using a frequency acquisition method after FFT.

articleTitle: Digital control in optical disc drives
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper deals with digital control in read-only and recordable optical disc systems such as CD audio/video, CD-ROM, CD-R/RW and DVD-R/RW. Since 1993, the rapidly growing data storage device market has forced fast system upgrades and new systems for extremely low market prices. Extensive system integration by means of special purpose ICs has minimized the number of external components and eliminated expensive adjustments during manufacturing by implementing auto-calibrating techniques.

articleTitle: Consumer electronics application and coverage constraints using Bluetooth and proposed Bluetooth evolution technologies
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper highlights key features of the Bluetooth physical layer standard. Typical link budgets and coverage plots are generated for an example residential environment. The results obtained for transmission of symmetric asynchronous data link (ACL) packets are used to discuss the bit rate capabilities of various time bounded and non-time bounded Bluetooth enabled consumer electronic devices. The need for higher bit rates in certain applications implies the need for a second Bluetooth standard.

articleTitle: JPEG compression factor control: a new algorithm
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose a new algorithm for the compression factor control (CF-CTRL) when the JPEG compression algorithm is used. It can be used, for example, in the digital still cameras (DSCs), where a minimum number of photos must be stored in a fixed size memory storage. So each file size must be constant. The most used compression algorithm used in the DSC is the JPEG one, that do not ensure a fixed file size, so a compression factor control algorithm must be used. This new method is based on the analysis of the Bayer pattern, the color pattern obtained by a CCD or a CMOS sensor, obtaining the JPEG quantization tables that ensure the target dimension of the JPEG file. The main characteristics of this algorithm are speed and power consumption.

articleTitle: Application of second generation advanced multimedia display processor (AMDP2) in a digital micro-mirror array based HDTV
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A second generation of the advanced multimedia display processor (AMDPZ) is applied in a consumer multimedia HDTV prototype system. The AMDP2 provides a cost effective and flexible platform which can be used to implement a wide array of video processing algorithms. Examples include interlace to progressive scan conversion, image scaling, and picture enhancement. This paper describes a DLP/sup TM/ HDTV architecture and the application of the AMDPZ processor to perform video processing algorithms for various input signals for display on a 1280/spl times/720 digital micro-mirror device (DMD).

articleTitle: Performance of H.26L video encoder on general-purpose processor
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: An optimized implementation of an H.26L video encoder is presented. Compared to H263, H.26L reduces the output bit rate about 25% at the expense of increased (3.8X) complexity. However, optimizations enable real-time operation on a 733 MHz general-purpose processor.

articleTitle: Suitability of turbo coded OFDM for LEO satellite channels in global mobile communications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is a robust transmission technique in Rayleigh and Rician fading environments. In this paper, turbo coding (TC) is considered with OFDM for a low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite channel. The bit error rate (BER) performance of turbo coded OFDM (TC-OFDM) for different modulation schemes are considered. Results are compared with trellis code modulated OFDM (TCM-OFDM) and convolutional coded OFDM (CC-OFDM). The results show that turbo coded OFDM gives the best performance compared to the TCM-OFDM and CC-OFDM for all modulation schemes considered.

articleTitle: Image retrieval using a novel relevance feedback for edge histogram descriptor of MPEG-7
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper, a relevance feedback method is proposed to improve the retrieval performance of the MPEG-7 edge histogram descriptor. Specifically, by updating the query point and the weighting factors simultaneously, we can reduce the convergence speed of the relevance feedback retrieval. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the performance significantly for natural and clip art images.

articleTitle: Digital camera for taking evidential photographic images
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes a system for taking evidential photographs by using digital watermarks and digital signatures and also describes a prototype camera demonstrating the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Efficient speech enhancement using spectral subtraction for car hands-free applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Over-subtraction of noise spectrum to enhance noisy speech has been proven an effective method. However, this method suffers from the tradeoff between speech distortion and musical noise artifacts. In this paper, we modify the original method to alleviate the tradeoff problem while retaining its simplicity. The proposed algorithm has been incorporated into the design of a car kit which is implemented on a low-cost fixed-point DSP with capabilities of voice dialing, echo cancellation and speech enhancement.

articleTitle: Robust error concealment algorithm for MPEG-4 with the aid of fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A new error concealment algorithm based on fuzzy set theory is proposed to repair damaged portions of the shape information. By the experiment results, the proposed algorithm has better performance than previous works especially on the case that the damaged portion includes the edge of object.

articleTitle: CEA-851 versatile home network (VHN)-a home intranet backbone for inter-cluster connectivity using IEEE 1394 and IP
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes CEA-851 versatile home network (VHN), a new home networking standard developed by the Consumer Electronics Association. VHN defines an IEEE 1394-b and IP-based in-home intranet backbone to connect previously incompatible home network clusters.

articleTitle: Multiplexing guard intervals and time domain pilots in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: DMB-T (terrestrial digital multimedia/television broadcasting), a DTTB (digital territorial television broadcasting) system based on TDS-OFDM (time domain synchronous orthogonal frequency division multiplexing), is introduced. TDS-OFDM employs time domain pilots for synchronization and channel estimation. Furthermore, the multiplex of guard intervals and time domain pilots to save bandwidth is explored.

articleTitle: The home networking system based on IEEE1394 and Ethernet technologies
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose the home networking system which includes various network technologies. Our home networking system consists of low-power IEEE1394 and Ethernet wall-plate, multi-core POF & UTP Cat.5 combination cable, IEEE1394-Ethernet bridge router and network control application based on Web server technologies. The characteristics of our home networking system are user friendly operation, seamless control, low-power and low-cost.

articleTitle: Storing digital video using an advanced optical storage device: data allocation and simultaneous record and playback
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Optical disc based video recorders have become available. We discuss the application format for a system based on an advanced optical rewritable system (DVR-blue). The high rate and capacity of the system enable recording of HDTV and new features like simultaneous record and playback of SDTV material along with seamless playback of edited material. We show that a set of allocation rules for the data combined with reference drive performance guarantees simultaneous record and playback for SDTV streams (/spl les/10 Mbps) using the concept of a large physically contiguous collection of data called a fragment.

articleTitle: Content-based video retrieval by indexing object's motion trajectory
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose a video retrieval scheme indexing the object's motion trajectory information. The motion trajectories of moving objects are partitioned by fixed time intervals. Each segmented motion trajectory is described using the coefficients of 2/sup nd/ order polynomials that represent the centroids of the moving objects in time evolution. The set of polynomial coefficients is used as a motion trajectory descriptor. The proposed scheme provides small-sized indexing and low matching complexity.

articleTitle: Printed inductors in RF consumer applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents the results of an investigation on multilayer planar inductors (printed inductors). A multilayer inductor design is described resulting in high value of inductance at small dimensions.

articleTitle: Region-based object tracking for multipoint video conferencing using wavelet transform
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The main features of our proposed wavelet-based video coder include: (1) a user-specified region of interest selection as to which the region can be changed by the user at any I-frame; (2) a dynamic region tracking technique by which the video is tracked and updated according to motion activity and (3) an adaptive bit allocation that allows the user to specify the relative quality between the foreground and the background. This architecture guarantees a high video quality in the region of interest while reducing the overall bit rate and the computation time. Experimental results confirm that the approach produces a good video quality even under low bit rates.

articleTitle: New concepts on denoising and sharpening of video signals
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a new concept for improving video signals. Separating noise from the images simultaneously with sharpening these images is one key idea. Thereby, the different frequency channels of the video signal are processed in different ways in order to achieve the most attractive effect on the human visual system. New algorithms including luminance transition improvement (LTI), contrast adaptive peaking in the case of the luminance, as well as chrominance transition improvement (CTI) in the case of the color components are presented. The whole image improvement concept including all its components will soon be produced in a 0.18 /spl mu/m technology as the display processor part of a new chip for 100 Hz TV applications.

articleTitle: Conversion between DV and MPEG-2 intra coding
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Conversion between digital video (DV) for digital video cassette recorder (DVCR) and MPEG-2 intra coding is performed in the DCT domain to reduce conversion steps. Multiplying the matrix by transformed data is used for 4:1:1-to-4:2:2 chroma format conversion and 2-4-8 DCT mode to 8-8 DCT mode conversion for parallel processing. M-quant of MPEG-2 rate control is computed in the DCT domain.

articleTitle: Providing multimedia services to a diverse set of consumer devices
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes an assortment of techniques and a system to adapt multimedia content. The ability to do so allows service providers to offer a wide range of multimedia services to users with various client capabilities. We present a system that is capable of serving a variety of client devices. To do so, we propose novel transcoding and video summarization algorithms. Additionally, we describe a system that invokes these algorithms dynamically as a function of the network, terminal and user information. The impact on the consumer is the added functionality that can be realized and the quality of their service.

articleTitle: Virtual editing of MPEG-2 streams
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Disc based video recorders for consumers bring the possibility of virtual editing, that is, editing without making a copy of the underlying A/V data. We propose a solution to support frame-accurate virtual editing that involves generating a new segment of MPEG-2 multiplex called a bridge sequence. Within the bridge sequence, some video is re-encoded and remultiplexed to ensure that the edited sequence can be played back seamlessly. The bridge sequence is stored on disc separately from the original sequences, which remain unchanged.

articleTitle: Integrated spatio-temporal noise reduction with implicit motion compensation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: 3D motion-compensated noise filters require two filters, a means to balance between the two, and motion estimation and compensation circuits. We present a high-quality low-cost integrated filter, which provides implicit motion compensation without using motion vectors.

articleTitle: Temporal aspects of emerging television displays
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: New display principles aim at supreme image quality. The temporal aspects of these devices sometimes remain underexposed, and the paper presents an overview of new artifacts and possible remedies with signal processing. We introduce a general approach, consisting of motion compensated picture interpolation and inverse filtering, to repair the image quality with signal processing. We conclude that motion estimation plays an enabling role in the reduction of display artifacts.

articleTitle: A dynamic-voltage-adjustment mechanism in reducing the power consumption of flash memory for portable devices
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A dynamic-voltage-adjustment method is proposed to reduce the power consumption of a flash memory storage system, depending on the system workload. The usefulness of the proposed method is demonstrated by a series of experiments with very encouraging results.

articleTitle: Adding full Internet protocol functionality to HAVi
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper looks at the current Internet access options in the HAVi home networking standard, and extends them to full IP access while remaining within the existing HAVi architecture.

articleTitle: Bandwidth reduction for video processing in consumer systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a strategy for substantially improving the memory (SDRAM) bandwidth in MPEG-type video-processing consumer systems. A new pixel-mapping strategy is proposed that halved the memory bandwidth for MPEG decoding using a sophisticated memory device (for example DDR SDRAM).

articleTitle: Temporal error concealment using two-step block matching principle
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A novel temporal error concealment technique based on two-step block-matching principle is proposed for reducing the degradation of video quality caused by errors. The recovery problem considered in the method is to search a best replacement for the damaged image from a reference frame. An improved performance using the proposed algorithm is achieved.

articleTitle: A single-chip MPEG2 MP@HL decoder for DTV recording/playback system
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents an MPEG2 MP@HL decoder LSI for use in recording and playback systems. It integrates digital broadcast recording and playback functions on a single chip, and enables smooth execution of trick plays with less computational requirements in an external CPU.

articleTitle: Video object segmentation based on global motion estimation/compensation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a video object segmentation scheme based on global motion estimation and compensation. For video sequences with or without camera motion, we propose a unified approach to extract the moving object models. This approach combines both the spatial information from current frame and the temporal information derived from global motion compensated frame. Experimental results demonstrate the validity and performance of our work.

articleTitle: A disk discrimination method for digital versatile disks using a fuzzy inference system
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A fuzzy inference system (FIS) is proposed for the determination of an optical disk type in a DVD drive. This FIS optical disk determination algorithm relies on the physical properties of the reflecting layer of an optical disk, using a DVD and CD photo diode outputs, to discriminate between several disk types.

articleTitle: An efficient memory arbitration algorithm for a single chip MPEG2 AV decoder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient memory arbitration algorithm for system on a chip. We have implemented the algorithm into a single chip MPEG2 AV decoder. According to simulations, memory access efficiency of the arbiter based on the new algorithm is around 95% with a 32-bit 133 MHz SDRAM, while those of conventional arbiters are less than 80%.

articleTitle: A low-power and scalable MPEG-4 solution for wireless communications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A full-duplex 5 GOPS low-power, high-resolution media processor is proposed. This media processor is ideal for battery-operated personal communication devices and is capable of handling MPEG-4 video and audio streams in Bluetooth, 2.5G, and 3G wireless communications.

articleTitle: Frequency domain equalization of IQ imbalance in OFDM receivers
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Digital receivers still include analog components in the demodulation process which cause amplitude and phase imbalance between the I and Q branch. This article describes a novel compensation scheme for OFDM receivers based on adaptive frequency domain filtering to remove the IQ imbalance effects.

articleTitle: Real-time recording technique and PC interface for the DVD-RAM camera
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents two technical features in the DVD-RAM camera. The first one is the real-time recording technique of DVD-RAM drive with power-saving management. The second one is the PC interface that provides an easy-to-use environment for handling user data, motion pictures and still pictures.

articleTitle: Real-time recursive motion segmentation of video data
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Segmentation is a hot topic for video compression and interpolation. We introduce a recursive algorithm that enables real-time motion segmentation of standard definition video on a DSP. The evaluation of the separate optimization steps is included.

articleTitle: Semiautomatic segmentation using spatio-temporal gradual region merging for MPEG-4
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose a new semiautomatic segmentation method using spatio-temporal similarity. In the proposed scheme, segmentation is performed using gradual region merging and bi-directional spatio-temporal refinement. Simulation results show the efficiency of the proposed method in semantic object extraction.

articleTitle: Fast carrier frequency offset compensation in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A speed-up algorithm to compensate the carrier frequency offset of OFDM systems is proposed when the offset closes to 0.5n, n=/spl plusmn/1, /spl plusmn/3, ..., times a sub-carrier space. We generate an additional offset compulsively after examining the closeness of the frequency offset to the points.

articleTitle: HJA: Java programming for CE devices
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper introduces HJA, a Java environment allowing 3/sup rd/ party developers to build applications that control and run on consumer electronics (CE) devices. HJA is contained within the Home Audio Video interoperability (HAVi) specification that has been defined by a group of consumer electronics manufacturers as a way to ensure the interoperability of digital home entertainment devices.

articleTitle: Single chip video processor for digital HDTV
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a new high-performance video system LSI using a 0.25 /spl mu/m CMOS technology for Japan BS digital broadcasting launched in December 2000. The LSI integrates all the necessary functions for video decoding into a single chip and employs efficient architectures which are parallel processing and have parallel data bus architecture for decoding transport streams efficiently.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of hierarchical storage management systems for video retrieval system
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents new performance comparison parameters for hierarchical storage management systems (HSMS) for video retrieval systems. These parameters are average access time and average operating time. The overall performance of the two prototype systems with HSMS, one with an optical disk and HDD and the other with magnetic tape and HDD, are described.

articleTitle: A transport stream processing LSI for HDD recording and playback of HDTV
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes a transport stream control LSI for digital HDTV receivers with HDD recording capability. A high performance HDD playback function using the partial transport stream is realized by a special designed RISC processor and the bitrate control algorithm in this new LSI.

articleTitle: WAP over Bluetooth: technology and applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Today, the vast majority of microprocessors goes into embedded systems which silently sneak into every corner of our everyday life. Until now, many of these processors only support standalone applications (e.g. household appliances), while the technology is there to make these appliances communicate to each other or humans wirelessly. At same time, WAP and HTML offer a general-purpose, interoperable presentation platform for user interfaces. Thus, many people believe that man-machine and machine-machine communication will be the next major paradigm shift for the information society. This article outlines the technology and applications focussing on wireless access protocol (WAP) and Bluetooth technologies.

articleTitle: LADIC-CAV: a flexible, programmable, high-speed laser driver IC for optical recording
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A high-speed integrated laser driver and controller circuit in standard CMOS technology works flexibly with optical recording formats such as CD-R/RW, DVD+RW, DVD write-once and DVR. It supports both constant angular velocity (CAV) and constant linear velocity (CLV) writing modes, and features a new laser power control method.

articleTitle: Design considerations for ISO/IEC 13818-1 decoders
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Important design considerations, principles and tradeoffs applied to the design of MPEG-2 transport stream demultiplexers suitable for integration with MPEG video/audio decoders and 2D/3D graphics core are presented. The described architecture integrates demultiplexing of the most frequent transport packets of MPEG HDTV video and audio streams into the register based hardware core and all digital teletext/subtitling decoding functions and user or private data processing on low to midrange performance host CPU (Pentium 200 MHz or MIPS 166 MHz). This results in the greater flexibility and reduction of the hardware cost of digital set-top receivers.

articleTitle: Simulation software of dynamic spatial channel assignment of wireless communication systems with smart antenna
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The paper demonstrates a simulation software package for dynamic spatial channel assignment of wireless networks with smart antennas. The software adopts a novel channel assignment algorithm with a smart antenna, which can optimize the performance of wireless networks.

articleTitle: Reception environment and channel estimation for digital television
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The Advanced Television Technology Center has completed a series of reception tests for digital television (DTV) in both indoor and outdoor environments. The tests included the capture and recording of actual DTV RF signals. An analysis of these signals has yielded an estimation of the DTV RF channel response under actual field conditions. The results show significant diversity in the channel conditions especially in the dynamic nature of multipath interference. This paper discusses the analysis technique with illustrations from actual field captures.

articleTitle: A Reed-Solomon decoder with the efficient recursive cell architecture for DVD application
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We implement a (208,192) Reed-Solomon decoder for the digital versatile disk (DVD). We propose an efficient Euclid cell and a VLSI architecture of a modified Euclid's algorithm (MEA) for the Reed-Solomoon (RS) decoder. We reduce the symbol time about 30% compared to the one based on the conventional architecture. A new MEA architecture has a recursive structure, in which the number of basic operating cells can be reduced, when the number of symbol time spent in the MEA operation is larger then codeword length n. We implemented an RS (208,192) decoder with the efficient recursive cell architecture using a FLEX10KE200 FPGA of ALTERA. The maximum decoding rate of this system is 20 Mbytes/sec, which is sufficient for DVD applications.

articleTitle: XML-based household profiling for home networks
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a generic XML (extensible markup language) based software system that can be installed on devices in a home network. The system enables dynamic change of behavior of a device, based on the state of the other devices in the network. Unlike existing user profiling systems, the proposed technology allows "local" profiling to occur without exposing sensitive information to third parties such as content providers.

articleTitle: An agent-based bidirectional intelligent remote controller
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose an agent-based bidirectional remote controller on a 32-bit MPU, and its usefulness is verified by the experiment.

articleTitle: Implementation of JPEG2000 codec on a fixed-point DSP
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper, the implementation of JPEG2000 codec on a fixed-point DSP is presented. This codec is capable of performing lossless and lossy compression, resolution and SNR scalability. Issues such as memory and bandwidth are taken into account for efficient DSP implementation.

articleTitle: Face detection for security system on the Internet
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose a face detection method for intelligent network cameras (INCs) based security system. Our method consists of two steps: candidate region detection and facial region detection. Experimental results show that the proposed method is applicable for real-time video surveillance.

articleTitle: An advanced camera system having fast autofocus control
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents an advanced camera system which performs a fast autofocus control under different scene situations. Experimental results demonstrate that proposed system can find the in-focus lens position precisely without the influence of noise.

articleTitle: Blind speech separation algorithm for dynamically mixing systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a blind speech separation algorithm that is capable of extracting a speech signal from background noise or music based on a microphone-array. A variable rearrangement is derived to convert convolution operations into a simple matrix multiplication in dynamically mixing systems. The fast fixed-point algorithm is then extended to separate a speech signal from background noise in a realistic room with acoustic reverberation.

articleTitle: MPEG-2 video transmission using the HIPERLAN/2 WLAN standard
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: At present, wireless local area networks (WLANs) supporting broadband multimedia communication are being developed and standardised. These will provide data rates up to 54 Mbps in the 5 GHz band. Highly compressed data such as video are extremely sensitive to the errors that are commonly encountered in wireless channels. This paper addresses the problems of transmitting MPEG-2 video over WLANs, and in particular HIPERLAN/2, and describes error resilient video transcoding as a means of handling channel errors.

articleTitle: Home information wiring system using a balanced cable for realizing a high-speed home-network
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a home-network adapter. The adapter enables simultaneous transmission of IEEE1394 and Ethernet using only UTP-CAT5. It is shown in this paper that the adapter can be used, without affecting other products.

articleTitle: MPEG-4 video codec for mobile multimedia applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: An MPEG-4 video codec (MoVa) has been developed for implementation of video coding applications according to 3G-324M. On 3G-324M, H.263 is mandatory and MPEG-4 is optional. However, MPEG-4 is proper for mobile multimedia applications (IMT-2000) by its error resilient and concealment tools. It can perform 30 frames/s of QCIF (SQCIF) or 15 frames/s of CIF at a maximum clock rate of 27 MHz for 128 kbps or 144 kbps. It meets the requirements for MPEG-4 SP@L2. A high bit rate and several sizes of video format are adequate for many applications, like videoconferencing, surveillance, news, or entertainment.

articleTitle: Remote execution of HAVi applications on Internet-enabled devices
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes an approach for extending the HAVi home network beyond its IEEE1394 physical layer by allowing remote access to it from any Internet-enabled device.

articleTitle: Impact of power limitations on the performance of WLANs for home networking applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper considers the application of 5 GHz wireless LAN technology to home networking applications. An assessment of physical layer performance is presented in the form of the achievable data rate as a function of received signal to noise ratio. The transmit power limitations imposed by the relevant regulatory bodies are also summarised. Based on this information, a state of the art propagation modelling tool is used to evaluate the coverage achieved by a WLAN system in an example residential environment in terms of the achieved data rate.

articleTitle: Video processing for single-chip DVB decoder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper deals with aspects of video processing for DVB decoder chips. The proposed architectures were implemented in a new DVB decoder IC. This IC comprises all units required for DVB decoding like system demux, MPEG video and audio decoder. To connect external devices it offers an ATAPI bridge, an IEEE1394 port, and other interfaces. Conventional analog video is supported by an integrated color decoder and text slicer. The analog inputs and outputs allow an easy integration in hybrid set-top box applications and integrated digital TV (IDTV) chassis. The first silicon was fabricated using 0.18-/spl mu/m eDRAM technology.

articleTitle: System-on-silicon solution for high quality consumer video processing-the next generation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents the next generation of a highly integrated low cost single-chip video processing system-on-chip with outstanding feature content and performance. The IC/sup 3/ unites the complete processing chain between tuner output (CVBS) and RGB processing. It comprises a perfected motion adaptive algorithm for high quality de-interlacing and up-conversion including a special cinematic source processing, picture-in-picture, split screen and manifold picture manipulation and improvement capabilities are implemented as well as color decoding and all necessary A/D and D/A conversions. All field memories are realized on-chip with YUV4:2:2 color representation up to SVGA resolution. Manufactured in a 0.18 /spl mu/m copper eDRAM technology, the IC meets economical demands with increased functionality.

articleTitle: Interference cancellation in CDMA downlink supporting variable rate services
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Variable transmission rate services such as Internet data access and voice communications will be supported simultaneously in the next generation wireless communication systems. Depending on the service types, different transmission rates and service requirements are needed. Therefore, different transmission power will be needed for different service users to keep the very high rate transmission. In this paper, an algorithm is presented for a low rate user to cancel the interferences from high rate users in CDMA downlink.

articleTitle: Wireless transfer of images from a digital camera to the Internet via a standard GSM mobile phone
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper we describe an infrastructure based on an existing, commercially available, GSM mobile phone for achieving connectivity between digital cameras and an Internet Website. Pictures are loaded from a standard digital camera, or compact flash card, by an embedded appliance, which establishes the Internet connection and controls the transfer of pictures from the camera to a remote website. Detailed descriptions are given of this picture transfer appliance and of a typical website infrastructure to store and manage the pictures and provide end-user services.

articleTitle: Novel image enhancement technique using shunting inhibitory cellular neural networks
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A classic problem in video mobile application is that lighting conditions are unpredictable and out of the user control. In such a situation even high quality video equipment may fail to reproduce good quality images. One example is when the dynamic range of a scene exceeds the camera's dynamic range, there can be a dramatical loss of visual information.

articleTitle: Two low cost algorithms for improved diagonal edge detection in JPEG-LS
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We present two low cost algorithms for improved diagonal edge detection in JPEG-LS. Experimental results show that the proposed schemes aid in the reduction of mean square error of up to 3 and 2 percent respectively as compared to the standard, for the same number of bits.

articleTitle: A fast finite field multiplier architecture for high-security cryptographic applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: As an indispensable part of modern consumer electronics, security applications such as smart cards and network securities play an important role. In fact, data security gets ever-increasing attention as people tend to communicate with each other by various electronic devices over networks. In this paper, a new approach on designing a finite field multiplier architecture is proposed. The proposed architecture trades reduction in the number of clock cycles with resources. This architecture features high performance, simple structure, scalability and independence on the choice of the finite field to provide maximum security to applications so that it can be applied to various fields of security-demanding consumer electronic applications.

articleTitle: Applications of MPEG-4: digital multimedia broadcasting
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The new MPEG-4 based broadcast system offers multimedia information with an excellent audio- and video quality to the mobile society. The combination of real time MPEG-4 encoding and decoding with the DAB-standard (digital audio broadcasting) enables for the first time a distortion free TV-reception in fast moving vehicles.

articleTitle: Signal processing for a rear-projection TV using a digital micro-mirror array
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A rear-projection TV using a digital micro-mirror array has been developed. This paper describes the overview of its digital signal processing design, and introduces the signal processing techniques applied to the rear-projection TV system. Newly developed techniques realize a high quality image conversion to 1280/spl times/720 pixels from various inputs that include NTSC, HDTV and PC, and picture enhancement that uses image histogram data to control the picture enhancement level is applied.

articleTitle: Integrated echo and noise canceller for hands-free applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a new integrated acoustic echo and noise canceller for hands-free communications that includes computationally efficient double-talk detection, residual echo cancellation, and IS-127 noise reduction. The proposed system was implemented in real-time using a 16-bit fixed-point DSP.

articleTitle: Optimal television scanning format for CRT-displays
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Current consumer-level priced and state-of-the-art scan-rate converters enable a spatio-temporal decoupling of the received video and the displayed video. This paper presents the results of a subjective assessment indicating the preferred CRT-display format.

articleTitle: Automated video chain optimization
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Video processing algorithms found in complex video appliances such as television sets and set top boxes exhibit an interdependency that makes it difficult to predict the picture quality of an end product before it is actually built. This quality is likely to improve when algorithm interaction is explicitly considered. Moreover, video algorithms tend to have many programmable parameters, which are traditionally tuned in manual fashion. Tuning these parameters automatically rather than manually is likely to speed up product development. We present a methodology that addresses these issues by means of a genetic algorithm that, driven by a novel objective image quality metric, finds high-quality configurations of the video processing chain of complex video products.

articleTitle: Architecture of retail set-top box application platform for digital cable network
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of open middleware of a retail set-top box. The middleware is a layer of software, also known as the application platform, which makes applications transparent of host operating systems and the vendor-specific hardware. An application written once can be run on any retail set-top box with such application platform with minimal or no modification.

articleTitle: OFDMA/TDD packet transmission system with an adaptive subcarrier selection scheme for asymmetric wireless communication services
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper proposes an orthogonal frequency division multiple access/time division duplex (OFDMA/TDD) packet transmission system with an adaptive subcarrier selection scheme to support high speed and flexible bit rate transmission in wireless local area networks (LANs) and home link. In the proposed scheme, the spectral resource ratio between the uplink and downlink is adaptively controlled by changing the frame format, coding rate and transmit power in the OFDMA/TDD system, according to the uplink traffic load estimated by the ratio of used to unused subcarriers at the base station. For suppression of inter-subchannel interference, packet-switching based transmission is employed in the uplink. Moreover, to enhance frequency selective fading immunity, a channel monitoring-assisted adaptive subcarrier selection scheme is employed. Computer simulation confirms that the proposed system is effective in achieving a low message delay system even under dynamically varying traffic conditions.

articleTitle: Implementation of an MPEG-4 enhanced digital TV set-top terminal
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of a prototype MPEG-4 enhanced digital TV set-top terminal. We make use of the embedded processor of a digital set-top terminal to implement a real-time MPEG-4 video decoder in software. The decoded MPEG-4 objects may be either displayed as a window overlaid on the main picture, or upsampled to display as a full-screen NTSC video. This prototype demonstrates the feasibility of incorporating an MPEG-4 decoder to an existing MPEG-2 digital TV set-top terminal to enable enhanced services.

articleTitle: An audio-video content abstraction program interface (CAPI) for home network applications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Organizations have defined several home network infrastructures for controlling consumer electronic (CE) devices. A shortcoming with existing infrastructures is their inability to abstract device controls into high-level audio-video services across a home network. Therefore, what is needed is an infrastructure that abstracts devices and their controls into high-level content services thereby promoting the deployment of user-friendly content centric applications. In this way, applications can be quickly developed eliminating CE devices from the AV-experience.

articleTitle: Wireless gateway for wireless home AV network and its implementation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose a wireless gateway for wireless home AV network. It interconnects between wired (IEEE1394) and wireless network. We show our implementation of the wireless gateway, which transmits AV control commands and high-quality AV data.

articleTitle: A novel error concealment technique for MPEG-2 video decoder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper proposes a new error concealment technique for the motion vectors which are lost in error propagation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method has better performance than decoder motion-vector estimation (DMVE), and much better than the algorithms obtained by conventional temporal concealment techniques.

articleTitle: /spl mu/VNC: an embedded module for low-cost Internet connectivity and interconnectivity of home appliances
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper proposes the /spl mu/VNC embedded module that provides low-cost Internet connectivity and interconnectivity of appliances. An experimentally assembled TV set can program a VCR using a program code selected from a projection of a remote PC screen.

articleTitle: A new moving picture coding scheme for scanning compatible broadcasting
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In digital broadcasting, interlaced and progressive scanning pictures may be used. MPEG-2 can encode both scanning pictures independently. We propose a new broadcasting system that has scanning compatible. To realize this, compatible coding method and pre/post-processing are discussed. New coding scheme is based on progressive scanning coding, and some improvement technologies are applied. This coding can save more than 30% bit-rate of MPEG-2 interlaced coding.

articleTitle: A reduced complexity loop filter using coded block pattern and quantization step size for H.26L video coder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper addresses a reduced complexity one-dimensional loop filter to simultaneously reduce blocking and ringing artifacts of H.26L video coder. A new one-dimensional regularized smoothing functional is defined and the regularization parameters controlling the degree of smoothness to two neighboring directions are determined by coded block pattern and quantization step size which are available both in the encoder and decoder. Therefore, no information is necessary to obtain the recovered image from the compressed video. The experimental results show the capability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Low power MPEG/audio encoders using simplified psychoacoustic model and fast bit allocation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We present novel MPEG/audio (both MP2 and MP3) encoder implementation techniques. Efficient methods of reducing the computational loads for the most compute-intensive routines are proposed. These methods are a simplified psychoacoustic model and fast bit allocation. By adopting them, the proposed encoders can produce an ISO/MPEG compliant bitstream with greatly reduced computational loads. Two separately implemented encoders verify the effectiveness of the proposed architectures in efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Decision-directed adaptive nonlinear canceller for optical read channels
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A simple scheme for asymmetry compensation in optical read channels is presented in this study. The simplicity and yet the effectiveness of this scheme makes it an excellent candidate for a practical implementation. The simulation results show that the use of such a compensator significantly reduces the bit-error rate (BER) at the detector output, especially for optical channels with severe asymmetry.

articleTitle: A scalable MPEG-2 bit-rate transcoder with graceful degradation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes a scalable MPEG-2 bit-rate transcoder which scales from low complexity, resulting in moderate picture quality to high complexity with much better quality. This algorithm presents a very fine grain scalability in terms of complexity, making this solution especially suitable for software implementations, in order to benefit from the available resources to increase picture quality.

articleTitle: A 1.0 Gb/s BiCMOS multi-channel optical interface transmitter and receiver chip set for high resolution digital displays
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper, a 1.0 Gb/s multi-channel optical interface transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) chip set is presented. For a high resolution liquid crystal display (LCD) operating up to SXGA (1280/spl times/1024) pixels) grade, we present a high speed serial digital video I/O scheme with low EMI, skew-tolerant and long transmission distance. The interface chip set has a data recovery system with /spl plusmn/1 bit skew compensation and a 8B9B encoding/9B8B decoding for dc balancing. The analog front ends of the optical interface such as laser driver in Tx and PD current detector in Rx are fully integrated in the chip set. The Tx consists of an encoder, a pipelined high speed serializer, and a vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) driver. The Rx consists of a transimpedance amplifier for PD input, a deserializer, and a decoder for each channel. Fully integrated low jitter PLLs are implemented for clocking in the chip set. With a single 2.5 V supply operating at 1.0 Gb/s, the power consumption of the Tx is 150 mW and that of the Rx is 230 mW. They were implemented in a 0.5 um, 3-metal BiCMOS process and occupy an active area of 3,170*3,440 mm/sup 2/ each.

articleTitle: A memory efficient motion estimator for three step search block-matching algorithm
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes an memory efficient array architecture with data-rings for the 3-step hierarchical search block-matching algorithm. With the efficient data-rings and memory organization, the regular raster-scanned data flow and comparator-tree structure can be used to simplify the control scheme and reduce latency, respectively. The results demonstrate that the array architecture with memory efficient scheme requires a smaller memory and low input ports.

articleTitle: Elevated speaker projection for digital home entertainment system
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a novel processing technique to enhance the sound images with playback over elevated loudspeakers for both two-speaker and multiple-speaker configuration. This is achieved by a specially designed inverse filter together with HRTF filtering.

articleTitle: A proposal for a unified digital platform
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The evolution of home entertainment and computing mirrors an increasingly digital and networked lifestyle of the new millennium. From digital direct broadcast satellite (DBS) to digital cable to digital TV (DTV) to digital personal video recorder (PVR), the living room is going digital. The home PC is also morphing into a multimedia machine that can do more interesting things such as gaming, photo and video editing and playback. Then there are information appliances for everything on the Internet, from Web surfing to online shopping to travel planning. The digital platform is a technical proposal for a new architecture for home entertainment and computing. It is motivated by the fact that today's consumer electronics (CE) appliances are simple, reliable, but less flexible and extensible. On the other hand, the PC is extremely flexible and extensible because of its open architecture, but more complex and less reliable. The design of the digital platform is also influenced by the emergence of hypermedia content.

articleTitle: ASIC design of color sequential driver for LCOS (liquid crystal on silicon) microdisplay devices
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose the hardware design of a color sequential control driver for LCOS (liquid crystal on silicon) display devices which are considered advanced microdisplay techniques in the next generation. The driver has been implemented and tested with an ASIC chip, and applied for actual systems like HMDs (head mounted display).

articleTitle: Connectivity solution to link a Bluetooth camera to the Internet
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The exposure of consumers to the Internet is opening up broad new markets for data-centric services and products. One of these new markets is that of wireless digital photography. A key to growing this emerging market segment lies in simplifying the mechanisms for connecting digital cameras and other sources of digital images to the Internet. We describe an infrastructure based on Bluetooth for achieving just such connectivity. A detailed description is also given of prototype implementations of each of these infrastructures.

articleTitle: A low power digital servo architecture for optical disc
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a new digital servo architecture that reduces power consumption significantly. This paper shows an example of the low power digital servo architecture, which reduces its current almost by 83%, compared to that of conventional digital servo. This architecture applies to the compact disc (CD), Video-CD (VD), digital versatile disc (DVD), CD-ROM, and DVD-ROM.

articleTitle: Parallel architecture for MPEG-4 visual ACE profile
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We present an innovative architecture for real-time video processing which is capable of manipulating 8 thousand pixels in parallel, and which uses the performance represented by this level of parallelism to achieve MPEG-4 visual ACE profile for real time interlaced CCIR-601 compression.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of real-time software-based H.261 video codec
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A real-time software-based H.261 video codec is addressed and implemented. The experimental results show that our system can compress video in CIF format over 30 fps and in QCIF at 105 fps.

articleTitle: Autostereoscopic adaptive 3D multi-screen system
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The new 3D system is a person-adaptive autostereoscopic multi-screen panoramic monitor (PAMS) which presents to the observer position-true real time scenes distributed over up to 3 TFT displays. All adaptive stereo pixel operations are done by a high performance 3D graphic board.

articleTitle: Multimedia ASIP SoC codesign based on multicriteria optimization
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper shows how to codesign a multimedia ASIP (application specific integrated processor) SoC (system-on-chip) to achieve a low-power and high-throughput goal for a consumer device. The codesign methodology applies Pareto's multicriteria optimization technique to analyze and partition the software/hardware, the instruction set and the memory hierarchy of an ASIP to provide a flexible approach of finding the best trade-off between conflicting goals based on a given weight function.

articleTitle: A single VSB/QAM/QPSK IC for ATSC and OpenCable/sup TM/ digital terminals
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a single chip which has been designed and implemented for the ATSC-VSB terrestrial receiver and the OpenCable/sup TM/ digital set-top terminal. It employs all-digital synchronization scheme for common VSB/QAM demodulation, and has a built-in QPSK modem for bi-directional cable signaling.

articleTitle: E-VSB-an 8T-VSB compatible system with improved white noise and multipath performance
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Enhanced-VSB (E-VSB) is a flexible, compatible outer coding enhancement to 8T-VSB which trades payload bit rate for improved white noise and multipath performance when properly equipped receivers are utilized. It is transparent to legacy ATSC receivers.

articleTitle: Designing low cost embedded system for multimedia data processing: Linux based micro kernel approach
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this article, we introduce the novel technique to design and implement a low cost embedded system for multimedia data processing. We use the skeleton of the existing Linux operating system and developed micro-kernel to perform a number of specific tasks for our purpose efficiently and effectively: memory management, video processing, input/output port control.

articleTitle: Image retrieval using color plane moment
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Among the features of content-bused retrieval, color features provide important clues to search similar image contents. In this paper, we propose a new method, color plane moment (CPM), which combines color content and its spatial distribution to improve image query results. The method integrates the ideas of a color histogram, back projection, and moments. Simulation results demonstrate the performance of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: A single-chip RF front-end for the digital sound broadcasting
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a single-chip RF front-end for the digital sound broadcasting. All RF circuits including LNAs, mixers, a PLL, a VCO, and an IF filter have been successfully integrated on a single-chip by employing the low IF architecture.

articleTitle: Personalized cache management considering spatial properties of data for mobile computing
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper proposes a personalized cache management method that supports user mobility and the spatial properties of data in order to support a wireless mobile service on the mobile host such as PDA.

articleTitle: Dynamic range compression based on illumination compensation
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a new method, which can effectively compress the dynamic range of a visual scene while preserving the local contrast to reproduce a high quality image on the devices with limited dynamic range. In this method, dynamic range compression is performed through a reduction of the the illumination effect, by taking into account the characteristics of the human visual system. Top precisely extract the illumination component with a reasonable complexity a multi-scale nonlinear filtering scheme has been developed.

articleTitle: A 79 dB-SNR 70 mW 18 MHz CCD front-end with fully-digital amplification scheme
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a fully monolithic 10 bit front-end for CCD cameras which incorporates a 14 bit ADC and a digital programmable gain amplifier (DPGA). With the adoption of fully-digital amplification scheme, it solves almost all the problems associated with the conventional front-ends. Test results show a 79 dB SNR (@ gain=0 dB) with a power consumption of 70 mW @ 18 MHz.

articleTitle: Mechanical characteristics of a new compact size color laser printer for home use
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Electrophotography has become a widely used technology for printing images on various printing media. Different types of color printers using this technology have been developed. However, most of the existing color printers are convenient for office use but are still too large and expensive for home or personal use. We have developed a compact size color laser printer that can be conveniently used for home use. This printer can produce high-quality color images and text on plain paper, postal cards, and transparencies at a print speed of 6 pages per minute (ppm) in color or 24 ppm in monochrome. Several new mechanical technologies have been developed, and the two main ones are described in this paper.

articleTitle: Development of a high-resolution surveillance camera with 520 TV lines
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have newly developed a high-resolution surveillance camera that has 520 TV lines horizontal resolution using a single-chip 410 k pixels color CCD. This camera realizes about 10% improvement of horizontal resolution compared with conventional camera having 470 TV lines horizontal resolution. This paper describes three technologies to improve horizontal resolution. These technologies can be also applied to a video camera recorder for consumer use.

articleTitle: H.26L intra mode encoder architecture for digital camera application
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: In this paper, a still image encoder based on the H.26L intra mode algorithm is proposed and implemented in a FPGA prototype board. H.26L was proposed by ITU-T to provide high compression efficiency for very low bit rate communication. The intra mode in H.26L (H.26Li) uses high level spatial prediction and provides 2 db PSNR gain more than the JPEG standard. It is suitable for still image camera application and can be further extended into video camera application.

articleTitle: An efficient error concealment implementation for MPEG-4 video streams
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents some error concealment results regarding damaged MPEG-4 bistreams. The chosen concealment algorithms are designed to fit in real-time decoders and provide a better PSNR and visually more plausible pictures than basic concealment techniques. In addition, the encoder impact on the visual quality of the reconstruction in presence of channel errors is highlighted.

articleTitle: One dimensional conversion of color temperature in perceived illumination
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper proposes a one-dimensional conversion method of color temperature in perceived illumination. It also presents the design and implementation of the method. The proposed method is verified using the Xilinx Virtex FPGA XCV 2000-6BG560. This method is demonstrated experimentally for color temperatures in the range of 3000 K to 25000 K. This can be applied into special effect for multimedia applications.

articleTitle: Subchannel power controlled COFDM system for the wireless-LAN
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We propose a subchannel power controlled COFDM system for wireless-LAN to support multimedia services. The proposed system gives about 3.1 dB gain in E/sub b//N/sub 0/ to support the required packet error rate, 10/sup -2/, compared with the conventional COFDM system under the multipath channel.

articleTitle: An efficient streaming and decoding architecture for stored FGS video
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
