abstract: FGS (fine granularity scalability) is the latest video-coding tool provided in the amendment 4 of MPEG-4 standard. We address a corresponding pair of efficient streaming schedule and pipeline decoding architecture to speed up the decoding process. The design may be applied to the applications of streaming stored FGS video and will benefit other FGS related applications.

articleTitle: Performance of OFDM with postdetection-combining-based macrodiversity on a shadowed multipath channel
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Performance of OFDM using postdetection-combining-based macrodiversity is analyzed on a shadowed multipath channel, and the effect of correlated shadowing is investigated. We show that the postdetection-combining-based macrodiversity gives larger performance gain than its selection-based counterpart, and yields much better performance than no diversity case even for the fully correlated shadowing situation.

articleTitle: A real-time practical video segmentation algorithm for MPEG-4 camera systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time practical video segmentation algorithm for MPEG-4 video camera systems. The processing speed of 40 QCIF frames per second can be achieved on a personal computer with a 800 MHz Pentium III processor. It can be integrated into MPEG-4 based videophone systems and digital cameras.

articleTitle: Automatic object segmentation for content-based video coding
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Video object segmentation is an indispensable process for content-based video coding. Accordingly, this paper presents an automatic video object segmentation system that can automatically extract and track moving objects. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Timing phase estimator overcoming Rayleigh fading for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A timing phase estimator and a frame selection algorithm which are robust to Rayleigh channels are proposed for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) receivers. The proposed system can reduce the influence of Rayleigh fading with low computational complexity compared to conventional systems.

articleTitle: Conformance test of MPEG-4 shape decoding
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Most of the current video coding standards, such as H.261 and MPEG-1, are frame based while MPEG-1 can encode objects. Shape coding is a process of coding a visual object. This paper proposes conformance test methods for BAB (binary alpha block) decoder, CAE (context based arithmetic encoding) decoder for intra and inter VOPs (video object planes), upsampling and downsampling. Our test generates all possible cases of binary shape encoding.

articleTitle: Digital stream processing technology for digital HDTV receiver with a HDD
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We developed a digital HDTV receiver with a HDD for digital broadcasting. This receiver provides simultaneous recording and playback of HDTV simultaneous recording of two programs and playback of one program.

articleTitle: Design optimization of MPEG-2 AAC decoder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: An optimized design for the 2-channel main-profile MPEG-2 AAC decoder is presented. For enabling efficient job scheduling and allocation, the design consists of three hardware modules: Huffman decoder, predictor, and processing core. The Huffman decoder is designed to complete the requested job within 1 clock cycle time and the predictor forms parallel processing with other modules, so that utilization of the system resource is maximized. The developed decoder decodes stereo MPEG-2 AAC bitstream in real-time using 16.9 MIPS with high efficiency.

articleTitle: A high density and high data transfer rate flexible disk drive for insertion to the PCMCIA type-II slot
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a new small, flexible magnetic-disk recording system which has the largest areal density (672 Mbit/sq in) in FDD formats and a 18 Mbit/sec maximum user data transfer rate. This is a new CFDD (Card size Flexible Disk Drive) format using a 1.75-inch disk on which 150 Mbytes of data can be stored.

articleTitle: Development of a BS digital broadcast receiver
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed new Japanese BS digital broadcast receiver featuring DSP-based MP@HL video and MPEG-2 AAC audio one-chip decoder, and an original real-time OS supporting all digital TV functions such as BML browser, EPG, and IEEE1394 interface.

articleTitle: Development of a new LC rear-projection display with an aspherical mirror projection system
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a new projection system that consists of an aspherical mirror projection system. This system realizes the small depth that cannot be achieved with the conventional rear projection lens. Furthermore, we have developed a new screen that realizes high brightness, good uniformity within the whole image area, a wide viewing angle, and reduction of the ghost image by obtaining the ideal conditions between each blaze angle of the Fresnel screen and the projected rays onto the screen.

articleTitle: High quality, cost-effective film-to-video converter for high definition television
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes a film-to-video converter that improves the motion portrayal of film material on high definition (HD) TV sets. To reduce the cost of motion estimation on HD resolution pictures, we use sub-sampled pictures to determine motion vectors. The motion vectors are then post-processed and used for up-conversion. A novel method of post-processing and up-conversion is introduced to obtain a high quality output.

articleTitle: Efficiency of low power audio amplifiers and loudspeakers
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper looks at the load presented to audio amplifiers by real transducers. We consider the power losses in class-AB and class-D amplifier topologies, and determine that in order to predict the efficiency it is necessary to consider the amplifier/transducer combination. The ability of the class-D amplifier to recycle quadrature load current offers new ways to improve the efficiency.

articleTitle: The system architecture of a large-screen multimedia TV using digital micro mirror array
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A system architecture was carefully designed for a multimedia large-screen TV using digital micro mirror array. It displays high fidelity HD video and XGA computer graphics with the 1280/spl times/720 pixels per progressive frame, together with variety of advanced user functions.

articleTitle: Actuator control to suppress disturbances for 8 cm DVD-RAM video camera recorder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We have developed a new actuator control technique for 8 cm DVD-RAM drive used for a video camera recorder. The developed technique consists of acceleration feed forward control (AFFC) and velocity feed back control (VFBC).

articleTitle: A low noisy triple channel graphic digitizer for UXGA compatible TFT LCD panels
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A low noisy graphic digitizer is composed of an AGC, ADC, and PLL. In order to satisfy the specification of triple channel UXGA compatible TFT LCD panels, novel techniques and algorithms are proposed. It has been fabricated with a 5 metal 0.25 um CMOS technology. The chip area is about 3.6 mm/spl times/3.2 mm with 520 mW power dissipation at 2.5 V power supply. The maximum jitter noise of the PLL is about 10 ps at 230 MHz clock speed. The INL and DNL of the ADC are within 1 LSB.

articleTitle: Post-processing using computationally efficient adaptive nonlinear filters for HDTV
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents a computationally efficient post-processing algorithm for HDTV. The proposed algorithm can reduce both blocking artifacts and mosquito noise while preserving the sharpness and naturalness of the reconstructed video signal. Performance improvements compared with other techniques are obtained according to simulation results.

articleTitle: An architecture and implementation of MPEG audio layer III decoder using dual-core DSP
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: An architecture of MP3 decoder using dual-core DSP is proposed and implemented. It is suitable for portable communication devices such as cellular phones because of its high audio quality, low-power consumption and cost efficiency.

articleTitle: Smart antenna receiver based on fixed BFNS system with space-time processing for CDMA communications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: The paper presents a new smart antenna receiver based on the fixed BFNS structure which can improve greatly the performance of a smart antenna with interference suppression. A novel interference suppression algorithm is developed at the same time.

articleTitle: Efficient RLL codes for optical recording
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: We report on new runlength-limited codes (RLL) intended for the next generation of DVD. The efficiency of the newly developed RLL schemes is extremely close to the theoretical maximum, and as a result, significant density gains can be obtained with respect to prior art coding methods.

articleTitle: Phase noise analysis of double-heterodyne TV tuner for 8VSB digital terrestrial broadcasting
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper describes a phase noise analysis of the double-mixing TV tuner for 8VSB DTV system. It proposes an accurate simulation method of the phase noise of the frequency synthesizers used in 8VSB DTV system. Also, we analyzed the performance of the DTV tuner in conjunction with the FPLL, in terms of symbol error rate.

articleTitle: Recursive metric for NTSC interference rejection in the ATSC-HDTV trellis decoder
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper derives the optimum metric associated with the NTSC co-channel interference case of the ATSC-HDTV trellis decoder and proposes a recursive formula for its implementation.

articleTitle: An implementation of edge-preserving filters using layered fuzzy controllers with learning
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: To achieve an edge-preserving noise reduction for mixed noise, several filters that employ a fuzzy controller have been proposed. The optimization method of the fuzzy controller parameters is one of the problem for these filters that have cascade connected or layered connected fuzzy controllers. In this paper, the method of tuning parameters in these types of the fuzzy controller is developed and is applied to the edge-preserving noise reduction fuzzy filter proposed by Takashima et al. (1993). Then a new edge-preserving noise reduction filter whose parameters can be optimized by learning is obtained. Simulation result shows the resulting filter can sufficiently improve the noise reduction performance of the original filter.

articleTitle: Networked multimedia system based on open architecture
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents the software architecture of a networked multimedia system for playing high quality multimedia content. The system models a search, preview and rent paradigm, allowing provision for billing the customers. The system is based on an open platform including consumer set-top boxes based on a PC processor with Linux operating system, Linux based media servers and IP networking.

articleTitle: A new era of mobile shopping based on intelligent fuzzy neuro-based shopping agents
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Owing to the increasing number of mobile e-commerce applications using WAP technology, intelligent agent-based systems have become a new trend of development in the new millennium. Traditional web-based agent systems suffer various degrees of deficiency in terms of the provision of 'intelligent' software interfaces and light-weighted coding to be implemented in WAP devices. In this paper, the author proposes a comprehensive and intelligent-based agent platform known as 'intelligent java agent development environment' for the development of smart (via the implementation of 'conscious layer'), compact and highly mobile agent applications. From the implementation point of view, the author introduces an intelligent fuzzy neural-based mobile shopping agent based on the integration of WAP and java servlets technology. Promising results in terms of agent mobility, fuzzy-neural shopping efficiency and effectiveness have been obtained.

articleTitle: An ADC with differential mode for CMOS image sensor
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: An ADC with differential mode is presented to increase the throughput and reduce the cost. The ADC is suitable for video applications, especially for CMOS image sensors.

articleTitle: CDSP: an application-specific digital signal processor for third generation wireless communications
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents an application-specific digital signal processor for third generation wireless communications. The processor architecture and instruction set are specially designed for the WCDMA system. These features make the proposed DSP outperform prior arts in terms of several crucial operations of wireless applications.

articleTitle: Motion vector composition algorithm for spatial scalability in compressed video
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper proposes a new algorithm to estimate the motion vector of the reduced low-resolution video by only using the original motion vectors and discrete cosine coefficients in the compressed bitstream. Higher quality and lower complexity are achieved.

articleTitle: The semantic score method for quantitative evaluation of video contents by viewers
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: Aiming to automatically generate video clips based on the viewer's evaluation of movies and TV dramas, the semantic score method, a content evaluation method to obtain quantitative, multiple-viewers' evaluation score for video content, together with a method to integrate the scores by averaging their absolute values, is proposed. Their effectiveness is then demonstrated through the evaluation of movie summary clips automatically created on an algorithm using this method.

articleTitle: A high performance, low power VLSI design of discrete wavelet transform for lossless compression in JPEG 2000 standard
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient VLSI methodology for realizing a discrete wavelet transform for lossless compression in the JPEG 2000 standard. The proposed method takes advantages of power-of-two format of wavelet coefficients, the linear phase property of FIR filters, the canonic-sign digit representation, and the common subexpression elimination technique to obtain multiplierless wavelet transformation. The proposed approach supports fast transformation and allows achieving very compact design. Besides optimizing the speed and area, this approach significantly reduces power consumption.

articleTitle: Access emulation and buffering technique for streaming of non-stream format video files
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: This paper introduces an access emulation technique using local buffering. Adopting the technique, a video server can serve a high number of video files over the network directly in store format without format conversion into another stream format. We have successfully prototyped an interactive movie-on-demand system using the technique.

articleTitle: New driving scheme for improving color temperature of plasma display panel-HDTV
publicationTitle: ICCE. International Conference on Consumer Electronics (IEEE Cat. No.01CH37182)
abstract: A new driving-scheme for improving the color temperature of plasma display panel-HDTV is proposed. Auxiliary pulses are only applied to address electrodes with blue phosphor layers during a sustain-period, thereby improving the color temperature of plasma display panel-HDTV.
